design: Retrospective held-out external sample; neither blinded nor prospective. All six H0LiCOW XIII released lenses; original MontePython likelihood factorization and column order. No cosmology-parameter chains or measured H0 used. No refit, lens exclusion, or new selection on the lens data.
geometry: Common flat effective distance-sum rule, D_d=D_M(z_d)/(1+z_d), D_dt=D_M(z_d)D_M(z_s)/(D_M(z_s)-D_M(z_d)); no predicted line-of-sight geometry or lens-mass effect from the optical model.
primary_score: Sum of ln L(p1) minus ln L(mirage), fixed plug-in point predictions, default upstream Scott bandwidth factor. Positive favors p1. LCDM is a fixed reference, not the primary comparator.
controls: Leave one lens out without refitting, Scott bandwidth multipliers 0.75 and 1.5, published-density scale from each single-lens covariance, lower training integration grid as input sensitivity; analytic constant-X flat distance check; likelihood-score identity under identical predictions; no significance or probability-of-model calculation.
